answer.reason: Several verses tell of events in Galatia: Paul's journey through it and his order to its churches.

clauses.english: was crossed by Paul, who strengthened all the disciples there
had churches that Paul ordered to set aside a collection for the saints
clauses.quote: as I have given order to the churches of Galatia

doubts: ACT 16:6, GAL 1:2, 2TI 4:10 and 1PE 1:1 only name Galatia in passing, so they were left unused.
The collection clause rests on 1CO 16:1-2, and it does not say the saints were at Jerusalem.
